# froe

> Froe is an inspectable coding agent for bounded work in a codebase. It makes precise changes in one Workspace, asks for approvals where required, and records enough metadata to reconstruct each run.

Use the README for installation, everyday CLI use, configuration, MCP integration, safety behavior, and development.

## Core documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xfq/froe/main/README.md): Installation, quick start, CLI use, configuration, MCP servers, safety model, observability, and development.
- [Configuration schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xfq/froe/main/froe.config.schema.json): Machine-readable configuration keys and validation rules.

## Optional

- [Evaluation harness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xfq/froe/main/evals/README.md): How the repository's agent-neutral coding evaluations are constructed and run.
